title: 01/10/20 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 01/10/20 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000066210 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. We updated the layout of the "upload photos" tab to show the name of the post when a member makes a multi-image post in their Member Dashboard. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums Upload We updated the layout of the "View Posts" page for each post type in the Member Dashboard. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Header Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums We fixed an issue which was causing the Verify Listing link in the Member Dashboard to submit empty copies of the Verify Listing form in some cases. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to search by keyword on the SEO Templates page in the Admin. We fixed an issue that was causing an error when exporting members from the Admin after searching for members by Top and Sub Level Category. We updated the "View Video Posts" page the Member Dashboard to show the video's thumbnail instead of showing the full video. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body datatable We fixed an issue which was preventing the Design Settings selected in the Admin from loading properly on member profile pages in some cases. We fixed an issue that was preventing users from searching for posts by country in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Group - Search Query Search - Post - Search Query We released a new Audio Streaming homepage widget. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout >> Homepage Section Order. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to expand the Post Location Map modal on member profile pages in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Post Location Map We fixed an issue that was preventing the Member Profile Analytics Add-On from logging the "Search Results Phone" clicks in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from saving the Edit Post Settings page when the Post Categories field was not present on the page. We changed the name of the "Google Maps Language" setting to "Default Website Language" on the General Settings page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from saving the homepage content when editing the Homepage static page in the Admin in some cases. We added a link to edit the Homepage static page when the "Custom Homepage Content" option is selected in the "Homepage Section Order" portion of the Design Settings page in the Admin. We added an alt attribute to the images displayed on the "Details Page" of Photo Album posts. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Photo Album Page We updated the logic of the " Export Member Data" Add-On in order to support export files with more than 300.000 member export records. We updated the menu at the top of the Admin to display the email of the Admin Account currently logged in when clicking on the "My Account" menu item . We moved the "Admin Roles" menu item from the Admin Sidebar Menu to the Admin Accounts page next to the "New Admin Account" button. We updated the Menu Manager page in the Admin in order to display all child items when the page first loads. We updated the Form Manager page in order to only show the "Options" field when the Field Type has been set as a Checkbox, Radio or Dropdown field. We implemented a security update in order to prevent SQL injections on search results pages. Widgets Involved: Search - Group - Search Query Search - Member - Search Query Search - Post - Search Query Search - Reviews - Search Query We enhanced the logic of the " Member Profile Analytics" Add-On in order to show the number of "Views" per post for single and multi-image posts. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body datatable Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums datatable For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
